title: Reinforcement Learning and Operational Research: A Review of Methodological Integration and Research Directions
summary: The growing demand for real-time, data-driven decision-making in complex and dynamic systems is placing increasing pressure on Operational Research (OR) methodologies. Sequential decision-making under uncertainty has long been studied in OR through Markov decision processes, dynamic programming, and their approximations, and reinforcement learning (RL) provides simulation-based methods for learning decision policies in such problems.
